# @honua/sdk-js

> One TypeScript/JavaScript geospatial client for Esri GeoServices, OGC API (Features/Tiles/Maps/Processes), STAC, WMS/WMTS, WFS 2.0, and OData v4 — a single protocol-neutral Dataset → Source → Query → Result contract, a MapLibre-first map runtime, and a drop-in ArcGIS migration codemod.

Capability gaps throw `HonuaCapabilityNotSupportedError` rather than returning empty data. The same `Source.query(...)` call works across every supported protocol; the raw protocol shape stays reachable through the typed `Source.protocol(...)` escape hatch. Installing the SDK also installs the `honua` CLI, and a standalone `@honua/mcp-server` MCP server lives under `mcp/`. For agents: prefer the current APIs documented below over any recalled from training data.

## Getting started

- [Honua JS SDK](https://github.com/honua-io/honua-sdk-js/blob/trunk/README.md): Project overview, install, 60-second quickstart, and the demo index.
- [Installing the Honua JavaScript SDK](https://github.com/honua-io/honua-sdk-js/blob/trunk/INSTALL.md): Install instructions and the subpath entrypoint / stability table.
- [Documentation versions and compatibility](https://github.com/honua-io/honua-sdk-js/blob/trunk/docs/documentation-versions.md): Current and archived SDK documentation versions, compatibility ranges, and migration fallbacks.
- [SDK sample catalog](https://github.com/honua-io/honua-sdk-js/blob/trunk/docs/generated/sample-catalog.md): Generated inventory of every executable SDK example, including support, data mode, lifecycle, and demonstration intent.
- [Five-minute quickstart: endpoint to linked MapLibre map](https://github.com/honua-io/honua-sdk-js/blob/trunk/docs/quickstart.md): 5-minute quickstart: query features and render them on a map.
- [Learn the Honua SDK by task](https://github.com/honua-io/honua-sdk-js/blob/trunk/docs/generated/learning-paths.md): Task-oriented progression from first public map through connect, query, styling, analysis, editing, realtime/offline, 3D, migration, and safe automation.
- [Standalone quickstart moved to First Map](https://github.com/honua-io/honua-sdk-js/blob/trunk/docs/standalone-quickstart.md): Server-optional front door: run the SDK against any public GeoServices endpoint with no Honua server, key, or account.
- [First Map troubleshooting](https://github.com/honua-io/honua-sdk-js/blob/trunk/docs/quickstart-troubleshooting.md): Common quickstart failure modes and how to fix them.
- [How Honua compares](https://github.com/honua-io/honua-sdk-js/blob/trunk/docs/comparison.md): Generated comparison page: bundle sizes vs @arcgis/core, protocol coverage vs raw MapLibre / arcgis-rest-js / OpenLayers, and the scripted time-to-first-map benchmark.

## Core contract and API

- [Shared Client Contract](https://github.com/honua-io/honua-sdk-js/blob/trunk/docs/shared-client-contract.md): Dataset / Source / Query / Result contract design and semantics.
- [Deterministic query planner](https://github.com/honua-io/honua-sdk-js/blob/trunk/docs/query-planner.md): Deterministic query IR and explain plans, GeoServices and OGC API Features pushdown, and safe bounded-local execution policy.
- [Columnar batch transfer contract](https://github.com/honua-io/honua-sdk-js/blob/trunk/docs/columnar-data-plane.md): Bounded dependency-free columnar batches, transferable backing buffers, ownership, cancellation, and receipts.
- [Resumable realtime delivery](https://github.com/honua-io/honua-sdk-js/blob/trunk/docs/realtime-resume.md): Durable realtime checkpoints, ordered resume, deduplication, gap handling, cancellation, and credential-free envelopes.
- [Plugin manifest and certification contract](https://github.com/honua-io/honua-sdk-js/blob/trunk/docs/plugin-manifest-certification.md): Versioned data-only plugin manifests with deterministic compatibility and authority-boundary certification.
- [deck.gl binary adapter (experimental)](https://github.com/honua-io/honua-sdk-js/blob/trunk/docs/deckgl-adapter.md): Bounded zero-copy typed-array projection into an optional deck.gl peer with deterministic lifecycle semantics.
- [Experimental Cesium entity adapter](https://github.com/honua-io/honua-sdk-js/blob/trunk/docs/cesium-entity-adapter.md): Bounded accepted-plan projection into an optional Cesium peer with stable entity identity and disposal.
- [Downloadable offline regions (experimental)](https://github.com/honua-io/honua-sdk-js/blob/trunk/docs/offline-regions.md): Bounded downloadable-region manifests, logical-byte quota CAS, byte isolation, integrity, and storage-neutral transactions.
- [Safe agent plan boundary](https://github.com/honua-io/honua-sdk-js/blob/trunk/docs/agent-safety.md): Bounded safe-agent plan normalization, signed approvals, authenticated single-use execution, secret-safe durable audit, MCP adaptation, and verifiable receipts.
- [Agent-safety threat model](https://github.com/honua-io/honua-sdk-js/blob/trunk/docs/agent-safety-threat-model.md): Threat model for the stable agent surface: envelope forgery, replay, effect-budget bypass, receipt tampering, and plan-fingerprint mismatch, each with mitigations and conformance tests.
- [Natural-language map control (@honua/sdk-js/nl-map-control)](https://github.com/honua-io/honua-sdk-js/blob/trunk/docs/nl-map-control.md): Natural-language map control: plan-first NL-to-plan compilation, BYO-LLM callback, agent-safety approval envelopes, receipts, and MCP/OpenAI tool publication.
- [North-star SDK application-kernel contract](https://github.com/honua-io/honua-sdk-js/blob/trunk/docs/decisions/north-star-sdk-application-kernel.md): Accepted-for-review application-kernel boundary and API: connect, inspect, explain, query, mount, provenance, and safe agent plans.
- [Provider-pluggable geocoding and routing](https://github.com/honua-io/honua-sdk-js/blob/trunk/docs/geocoding-routing-providers.md): Provider-pluggable geocoding (Nominatim/Photon/Pelias/Honua) and routing (OSRM/Valhalla/Honua): setup, capability differences, and attribution/usage-policy obligations.
- [Protocol × Capability Matrix](https://github.com/honua-io/honua-sdk-js/blob/trunk/docs/protocol-capability-matrix.md): Which operations each protocol supports and where capabilities fall back.
- [Backend-Agnostic vs Honua-Server-Enhanced Capability Matrix](https://github.com/honua-io/honua-sdk-js/blob/trunk/docs/standalone-capability-matrix.md): Backend-agnostic vs Honua-server-enhanced capabilities: what works with no server and what needs one.
- [Cross-SDK Surface Alignment](https://github.com/honua-io/honua-sdk-js/blob/trunk/docs/sdk-surface-alignment.md): Cross-language naming parity and the semver / stability policy.
- [Error reference](https://github.com/honua-io/honua-sdk-js/blob/trunk/docs/errors.md): Named error hierarchy, catch-narrowing, and retry policy.
- [Authentication](https://github.com/honua-io/honua-sdk-js/blob/trunk/docs/auth.md): Authentication: pluggable auth providers, OAuth2 authorization-code + PKCE, token refresh, credential stores, and security guidance.
- [React bindings (@honua/react)](https://github.com/honua-io/honua-sdk-js/blob/trunk/docs/react.md): @honua/react bindings: HonuaProvider, useQuery/useDataset hooks, and map components.
- [@honua/geometry — client-side geometry operations](https://github.com/honua-io/honua-sdk-js/blob/trunk/docs/geometry.md): @honua/geometry client-side ops (buffer/area/measure/simplify/reproject) and the geometryEngine compat shim coverage table.
- [Bundle sizes](https://github.com/honua-io/honua-sdk-js/blob/trunk/docs/bundle-sizes.md): CI-enforced per-entrypoint bundle sizes (min + gzip) with budget policy.
- [@honua/sdk-js reference guide](https://github.com/honua-io/honua-sdk-js/blob/trunk/docs/guide.md): Long-form reference: server compatibility, entrypoints, protocol cookbooks, auth bridge.

## Protocols

- [OGC API Client](https://github.com/honua-io/honua-sdk-js/blob/trunk/docs/ogc-api.md): OGC API Features / Tiles / Maps / Processes and STAC cookbooks.
- [WFS 2.0 adapter](https://github.com/honua-io/honua-sdk-js/blob/trunk/docs/wfs.md): WFS 2.0 adapter usage, filters, and exception handling.
- [GeoParquet / DuckDB-WASM source](https://github.com/honua-io/honua-sdk-js/blob/trunk/docs/geoparquet.md): GeoParquet / DuckDB-WASM Source: contract Query compiled to SQL over read_parquet, spatial pushdown, Overture recipe.
- [WebMap JSON Compatibility Contract](https://github.com/honua-io/honua-sdk-js/blob/trunk/docs/webmap-json-compatibility.md): Parsing Esri WebMap JSON into Honua sources and MapLibre style.

## Map runtime

- [Renderer objects and temporal playback](https://github.com/honua-io/honua-sdk-js/blob/trunk/docs/renderers.md): First-class renderer objects (classBreaks/uniqueValue/heatmap/cluster) with legend contracts, bridge integration, and temporal playback.
- [MapLibre GL JS Runtime (@honua/sdk-js/runtime)](https://github.com/honua-io/honua-sdk-js/blob/trunk/docs/maplibre-runtime.md): loadMapPackage() and HonuaMapRuntime — render a MapPackage on MapLibre GL JS.
- [terra-draw sketch binding (@honua/sdk-js/runtime)](https://github.com/honua-io/honua-sdk-js/blob/trunk/docs/terra-draw-sketch.md): terra-draw sketch binding: optional-peer draw modes adapted onto the edit-sketch workflow with undo/redo, snapping, and applyEdits.
- [PMTiles](https://github.com/honua-io/honua-sdk-js/blob/trunk/docs/pmtiles.md): Native PMTiles support: auto-registered pmtiles:// protocol, lazy peer, describe() metadata, and a CDN recipe.
- [Prebuilt browser bundle (CDN / build-less)](https://github.com/honua-io/honua-sdk-js/blob/trunk/docs/browser-bundle.md): Build-less CDN / IIFE usage via the prebuilt browser bundle.
- [Studio Package Contracts (@honua/sdk-js/studio)](https://github.com/honua-io/honua-sdk-js/blob/trunk/docs/studio-package-contracts.md): Studio package-family projections, validation envelope, and capability manifest.

## API entrypoints

- [@honua/sdk-js](https://github.com/honua-io/honua-sdk-js/blob/trunk/src/index.ts): @honua/sdk-js — reviewed common workflow.
- [@honua/sdk-js/honua](https://github.com/honua-io/honua-sdk-js/blob/trunk/src/honua.ts): @honua/sdk-js/honua — the Honua-first SDK entrypoint.
- [@honua/sdk-js/contract](https://github.com/honua-io/honua-sdk-js/blob/trunk/src/contract/index.ts): Shared client contract — canonical types and source factories that all protocol adapters speak.
- [@honua/sdk-js/query-planner](https://github.com/honua-io/honua-sdk-js/blob/trunk/src/query-planner/index.ts): @honua/sdk-js/query-planner — deterministic query IR, explain plans, and bounded execution for the protocol-neutral contract.
- [@honua/sdk-js/agent-tools](https://github.com/honua-io/honua-sdk-js/blob/trunk/src/agent-tools/index.ts): Agent-facing tool schemas and executors for bounded map/runtime actions.
- [@honua/sdk-js/agent-safety](https://github.com/honua-io/honua-sdk-js/blob/trunk/src/agent-safety/index.ts): Deterministic safety boundary for JSON-compatible agent plans.
- [@honua/sdk-js/nl-map-control](https://github.com/honua-io/honua-sdk-js/blob/trunk/src/nl-map-control/index.ts): Natural-language map control: compile NL instructions into serializable, inspectable plans over the agent-tools surface, and execute reviewed plans only.
- [@honua/sdk-js/esri-compat](https://github.com/honua-io/honua-sdk-js/blob/trunk/src/esri-compat-entry.ts): Esri ArcGIS JS-API compatibility wrappers (FeatureLayerCompat, MapViewCompat, ...).
- [@honua/sdk-js/migration](https://github.com/honua-io/honua-sdk-js/blob/trunk/src/migration-entry.ts): Codemod, scanner, and reporting used by the honua-migrate CLI.
- [@honua/sdk-js/runtime](https://github.com/honua-io/honua-sdk-js/blob/trunk/src/runtime/index.ts): @honua/sdk-js/runtime — MapLibre GL JS-first runtime for Honua MapPackage.
- [@honua/sdk-js/geocoding](https://github.com/honua-io/honua-sdk-js/blob/trunk/src/geocoding/index.ts): @honua/sdk-js/geocoding — HonuaGeocodingClient for forward / reverse geocoding and typeahead suggestions over a Honua-hosted GeocodeServer.
- [@honua/sdk-js/routing](https://github.com/honua-io/honua-sdk-js/blob/trunk/src/routing/index.ts): @honua/sdk-js/routing — provider-pluggable routing: the typed RoutingProvider contract plus first-party OSRM and Valhalla adapters and the Honua facade bridge.
- [@honua/sdk-js/expr](https://github.com/honua-io/honua-sdk-js/blob/trunk/src/expr/index.ts): @honua/sdk-js/expr — Honua expression builder.
- [@honua/sdk-js/webmap](https://github.com/honua-io/honua-sdk-js/blob/trunk/src/webmap/index.ts): @honua/sdk-js/webmap — WebMap JSON parse + symbol / renderer / popup converters.
- [@honua/sdk-js/geoparquet](https://github.com/honua-io/honua-sdk-js/blob/trunk/src/geoparquet/index.ts): @honua/sdk-js/geoparquet — a GeoParquet / DuckDB-WASM–backed Source.
